description: DEP-05 §When a quorum_expired dispute ends: a QuorumBegin after the dispute's fork point (last_valid_sequence) ends it unless its confiscation already confirmed; a quorum_expired DisputeEnter is armed on only while its ground stands (anchor past the governing expiry, no re-establishment since). Judged from the ledger, never the chain tip. Under strict-lottery-v8 (ruleset, judged at the dispute's fork point; ruled 2026-11-15 as an amendment to REVIEW 11) a re-establishment ends it only once its spend of the vault confirmed (rotation_spend_confirmed): a recorded QuorumBegin that is still unspent leaves the dispute standing, and armed on, and the race goes on. A case without a ruleset is read under one before v8.

ended.name: re-established, but the confiscation confirmed first
the QuorumBegin at the fork point is the one the dispute is about
soak ledger A: disputed at 72257 (expiry 4373), re-established at 73657, expired again
v8: re-established, recorded but unspent: the dispute stands (regtest 2026-11-15: the reference yielded here while its own confiscation sat in the mempool)
v8: re-established, its rotation spend confirmed: ended
v8: the confiscation confirmed first: not ended
before v8: re-established, recorded but unspent: ended (the reading the frozen rulesets keep)
